text:
alice_support: Heads-up — ACME (ticket ACME-438) just escalated: their prod assistants suddenly started returning much more "creative" answers after last night's rollout. Customer reports previously deterministic replies are now more verbose and sometimes hallucinating. They included examples.

emma_cs: Oof. They said it started ~2026-03-16 22:05 UTC after we pushed the config rollout. Request IDs: r-0a1b2c3d, r-0a1b2c3e.

acme_prod_team: here are 2 examples — before vs after. BEFORE: short bullet list, factual. AFTER: long narrative invented facts. We didn't change prompts.

alice_support: Can someone from eng confirm if any sampling defaults changed in the deploy? Also need repro steps so support can respond.

bob_ml: Looking now. I see a config change in the serving defaults merged in release 2026-03-16T21:50Z. It was intended to standardize sampling across channels. Patch:

```
# serving-defaults.yaml (diff)
- sampling:
-   temperature: 0.0
-   top_p: 1.0
+ sampling:
+   temperature: 0.7
+   top_p: 0.9
```

bob_ml: That would absolutely explain more stochastic outputs for customers that relied on deterministic behavior. The change touched the "unified-presets" rollout.

carol_pm: Why did we change customer-facing defaults without a migration/notice? This was meant for new model families only.

bob_ml: It rolled via the config propagation job that missed the per-customer override check for legacy workloads. My mistake on the canary rule — it applied globally.

dave_oncall: I'm creating a rollback patch and a hotfix flag to respect per-customer preset. Holding on pushing until we validate.

deploy-bot: deploy started: release/2026-03-16-unified-presets (canary -> 100%). status: success. commit: 3f9b7a1

dave_oncall: Action plan: 1) rollback sampling defaults for customers with deterministic workflows (ACME included) 2) push customer-specific override so saved project config wins 3) notify CS + set follow-up call. I will attempt rollback now.

bob_ml: Repro snippet from ACME's customer payload they shared (they didn't set temperature/top_p):

```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <KEY>
{
  "model": "gpt-reasoner-2",
  "input": "Summarize the incident in bullets",
  "max_tokens": 120
  # no temperature or top_p provided -> falls back to service default
}
```

bob_ml: When the service default was temp=0.0, this produced deterministic short bullets. After default flipped to 0.7/0.9, same call yields creative narrative.

emma_cs: ACME is asking for an ETA on rollback and whether their usage will be charged for noisy outputs.

dave_oncall: Rollback in progress. Applying hotfix flag: `preserve_legacy_sampling: true` for project acme-prod.

deploy-bot: hotfix deploy started: hotfix/preserve-legacy-sampling. status: in_progress.

dave_oncall: Hotfix applied to acme-prod project. Confirming by hitting same request IDs — logs show sampling settings now: temperature=0.0 top_p=1.0.

bob_ml: I verified with a local repro against canary and prod. With explicit settings omitted, legacy projects now get the old defaults. Added a unit test + integration test to prevent global overwrite. PR: #1427.

emma_cs: Messaging for ACME: apologizing, outline fix, offer a call + credits if they want. Draft reply: "We identified a config change that unintentionally altered sampling defaults for legacy projects; we've restored your previous settings and are rolling out a permanent guard. We're available to review any generated content and will issue a credit if required." Any edits?

carol_pm: Add exact timeline and commit hash + mention permanent guard rails and opt-in for unified presets.

alice_support: Sending the update to ACME now. Ticket ACME-438 updated with hotfix details and PR link.

acme_prod_team: Thanks for the quick response. We'll validate tomorrow morning and report back. Appreciate the proactive rollback. :pray:

bob_ml: Follow-ups: 1) schedule postmortem in eng-ml 2) audit other model families for similar default drift 3) add an alert if sampling defaults change for projects with flagged deterministic workflows.

dave_oncall: Postmortem slot for Mon 10:00UTC. I've added the alert work to the oncall backlog.

alice_support: Closing slack loop — will keep thread updated if ACME re-opens.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: hotfix/preserve-legacy-sampling. status: success. duration: 00:11:24.

emma_cs: ACME confirmed deterministic behavior restored in their nightly run. Marking ticket as resolved pending 24h stability.

alice_support: Summary for records: root cause = unintended global rollout of new sampling defaults (temp/top_p) -> behavior drift for customers relying on old deterministic defaults. Remediation = hotfix to respect per-project legacy sampling + PR to add tests and alerts. Owner: bob_ml + dave_oncall + carol_pm.

alice_support: Tagging for docs update: we need a note in the breaking-changes/rollouts doc about sampling default changes and communication protocol.

carol_pm: Will own the customer comms template.

acme_prod_team: thanks again.
